summary: Frontend-only regression for AMYA homepage refinement. Verified blank-image bug fix for Nuvvula Podi and the 6 other non-pickle product cards at mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x1080). All 7 target images loaded with naturalWidth>0. Verified hero buttons navigation, 'AMYA Difference' 3-item section, no overlap between floating WhatsApp FAB and Add-to-Cart, cart WhatsApp link, and ProductDetail pack selection for Cashew Brittle (incl. 10 kg ₹8,500).
critical_code_review_comments: Console warning on home: 'container has non-static position' from a scroll-offset calc – cosmetic, not blocking.
Two 401 responses from a 3rd-party asset request observed on page load (not from our /api). Non-blocking but worth investigating origin (possibly an analytics/auth probe).
DialogContent (CartDrawer) emits 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' React warning – add DialogDescription or aria-describedby for a11y.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Product detail route is /product/:slug (not /products/:slug). Pack testids: pack-0..pack-n. Cashew has 3 packs (500g ₹500, 1kg ₹900, 10kg ₹8,500). Floating WhatsApp FAB (bottom-right) does NOT overlap product add-to-cart buttons at 390px. Cart WhatsApp link correctly contains wa.me/919675334567.
